verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs describe a CLI command that starts its OpenAI-compatible API server, and an official Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) that runs the same server. The server works with 200+ Hugging Face architectures, plus Transformers-backend models and custom models via `--trust-remote-code` in online serving, which covers the "any loaded model" part. A community user confirms they use the OpenAI-compatible API with ChatGPT applications. Missing for 10: a documented list of which OpenAI endpoints the server implements, and hands-on evidence of launching the server against an arbitrary model.
